item.title: Show HN: Semantic Art – Uses natural language prompts to find real artwork
The Sodium-Ion Battery Revolution Has Started
item.description:
📝 Sodium-ion batteries have been in the works for years, and now sodium-ion batteries have started to appear in cars and home storage. JAC, in a partnership with Volkswagen, has been shipping a vehicle called the Sehol or E10X with sodium-ion batteries since 2023. Since then, both BYD and CATL have opened huge sodium-ion battery factories.
🔗 Read more: https://cleantechnica.com/2025/10/22/the-sodium-ion-battery-revolution-has-started/
